instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral schematic package `harness_sheet` is on the desktop. Restore the specified harness component values/comments. Requirements: - Write `harness_sheet_fixed.edif`, `harness_sheet_fixed.schematic.json`, and `component_properties.csv`. - Set `R3` to `10k`; keep `R6` at `4.7k` and set its Comment to `Feedback 4.7k`; keep `J1` at `CONN7` and set its Comment to `Connector 7-pin harness`. Do not change unrelated components. Report every component in `component_properties.csv` using header `Reference,Value,Comment`, with an empty Comment when absent. [Software] Altium Designer is available at `D:\Altium\AD26\X2.EXE`. OrCAD Capture is available at `D:\orcad\tools\bin\Capture.exe`. OpenSCAD is available as `openscad`.
